Getting started

This guide installs the SDK, configures a client and sends a first request. It takes about five minutes and needs Python 3.9 or newer.

Install

Install the package with your package manager of choice:

pip install widget-sdk

Configure

Create a client with your key. The key is read from the WIDGET_KEY environment variable when you do not pass one.

from widget import Client

client = Client(timeout=30)
print(client.ping())
const client = new Client({ timeout: 30 });
await client.ping();

Options

OptionTypeDefault
timeoutint30
retriesint2
